ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels in the central regions and 25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the periphery and in focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity perimeter along the trailing edge. Central vertical low-intensity band adjacent to the median notch. Scattered low-intensity stochastic mottling across both lobes. Localized yellowish-tan chromatic shift observed on the right lobe interior surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 52 degrees; vertical depth extends approximately 15% into the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude serration profile with irregular, jagged peak-to-valley transitions; significant deep notches observed at coordinates corresponding to the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory; the left lobe exhibits a steeper upward terminal sweep at the distal tip compared to the more horizontal orientation of the right lobe tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distributed clusters of small, circular low-intensity pixel groups (<10 pixels diameter) concentrated primarily near the trailing edge and central-right lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical low-intensity linear disruption on the mid-left lobe; series of parallel, diagonal rake-like linear markings visible on the medial-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue discontinuities and deep notches along the trailing edge boundary; distinct vertical linear scar on the left lobe breaking the high-intensity pixel field.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown biofilm/staining localized on the right lobe, contrasting with the cleaner high-intensity white of the left lobe.
